name: Lucia
source:
The third prince of the Fasan Kingdom. The Witch's Curse makes him transform into a duck. He's a quick thinker who's specialty is being able to get out of quarrels simply by using words. His motor skills aren't that good, unless it comes to escaping from combat. Because he's prone to being overweight, he's on a permanent diet.

[From [url=http://www.otomate.jp/beast/flower_snow/chara/]Official site[/url]]
